verdict.rationale: Mangopay exposes agent-usable surfaces: an llms.txt with explicit instructions for AI agents, a public OpenAPI spec, markdown versions of every docs page, and a documented MCP server. Its API covers wallets, payouts, and contestable disputes where the platform provides proof, so an agent can plausibly work the money side through it. However, the MCP server sits on the docs domain and may be docs-only rather than operational, and the specific workflows in the story are thinly evidenced. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server can perform account operations (read balances or payouts), documented payout-status or failure investigation flows, a documented dispute-evidence submission endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents doing this work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the money side — read balances and payouts, investigate a seller's missing payout, draft dispute evidence — against documented, agent-usable surfaces
